assumptions: THIS INCREMENT adds the CI step 'Print the review tier and lane (informational, gates nothing)' (RFC-2026-034 §8 item 2; RFC-2026-030 §9 item 2 and §10 item 2). It runs the base's copy of scripts/db/classify-review-tier.mjs (with classify-records-only.mjs beside it) before npm ci, prints tier and lane between stop-commands markers and in the escaped, capped job summary, writes no step output and exits 0 on every path; anything other than a full classification prints tier H and lane governance, not classified.

The classifier (WP-0A-DB-00's file, declared amendment) gains laneOf and formatLane: the RFC-2026-034 §2.2 governance path list (each pattern marked never, guard or additive), the transitive local imports of scripts/db/run.mjs, rls-smoke.mjs and authz-proofs.mjs read from the head (fail closed), the audit lane (one evidence/audits/<date>/ directory on WP-0A-A0-001's branch), records, risk for H and fast for M and L. additive-eligible is printed when only additive-coverable guard paths make the PR governance; it never lowers the lane, it tells the readers A1 and Q0 may confirm the risk lane in writing. Without --lane the output is unchanged.
On this pull request itself the base's classifier has no --lane, so the new step prints not classified (governance); that is the step failing closed, as designed.

Governance pull request (RFC-2026-034 §2.2): C0, A1, Q0 and R0 read the final head; A0 presses it under the Owner's answer to Q-034-6 (i) of 2026-10-11 once all four pass and CI is green on the exact head.

acceptance_results.criterion: The new step gates nothing, fails closed, runs the base's copy before npm ci, prints inert; laneOf follows RFC-2026-034 §2.2
acceptance_results.result: pass for author self-check: 7 new tests in test-kits/branch-scope.test.mjs and 2 in test-kits/db/foundation-contract.test.mjs; independent reading owed

tests.result: clean: exit 0 — the full suite under the suite lock
every changed path declared, every amendment explains one

security_privacy_cost_impact: Changes CI by one informational step that gates nothing and writes no step output; the classifier gains a print-only lane function. No credential, secret, customer data or provider call; the step runs only the base's copy of the classifier, before any of the pull request's own code.
compatibility_impact: No contract changes: CI, a classifier and tests; no contract-catalog file.
known_limitations: The lane is information for the readers; nothing gates on it yet. The fast lane also needs a module on M_ELIGIBLE_MODULES (RFC-2026-034 §8 item 5) or an L web path, and none exists today.
Import roots are run.mjs, rls-smoke.mjs and authz-proofs.mjs; fixtures the harness loads by readFile are covered by the db/foundation/** and tests path patterns only as far as those patterns reach.

A test that pins CI or a classifier is marked never-additive by name (branch-scope, repository-json, test-coverage-floor); foundation-contract.test.mjs stays additive-coverable, as RFC-2026-034 §2.2 allows new tests there, and the readers judge whether a new test pins the classifier.
open_risks_or_blockers: GOVERNANCE, tier H, full path: C0, A1, Q0 and R0 on the final head; A0 presses under Q-034-6 (i) once all four pass and CI is green on the exact head containing main. Amendment acknowledgements owed from WP-0A-DB-00, WP-0A-A0-002 and WP-0A-CON-008.
